def evolved_op(o, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Formula: o[i, j] = i + 1 for all j
    # Depends only on row index i -> value (i+1) broadcast across columns.
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=o.device)
    col = (idx + 1).view(N, 1).expand(N, N).contiguous()
    return col.to(o.dtype)
